# Parley v0.1.66

This unnotarized test beta is the first cut from GitHub again. It updates the
embedded Ghostty terminal and the Sparkle updater, and changes nothing in how
the app behaves day to day.

## Where Parley lives now

- Source, CI and releases are at `github.com/markjoyeuxcom/parley`. The
  GitLab project is kept only as history; releases v0.1.25 to v0.1.65 remain
  there.
- Checks run on GitHub's hosted Apple-silicon runners. The two Docker-only
  checks are skipped there by name and still run on a Mac with Docker.
- The engineering guide (`AGENTS.md`) now holds standing rules only; its
  rationale and history live in the Prax library, as do five dated design
  and validation records that used to sit under `docs/`. The living guides
  (`docs/container-images.md`, `docs/test-scenarios.md`, the image recipe)
  stay in the repository.
- `npm run test:vm` runs the whole suite inside a local Tart macOS VM, so the
  Ghostty windows the checks open never land on your own screen.

## Updated dependencies

- **Ghostty** moves from upstream commit `3c47ca15` (22 September) to
  `0538f753` (29 September) through libghostty-spm 1.6.20261003, the last
  wrapper release that builds with the Command Line Tools alone. The
  display-link deadlock fix from v0.1.61 is still present (the commit is
  ahead of `72cf508`). The wrapper's display-link package is now DisplayLink
  3.0.1; the third-party notices name it.
- **Sparkle** moves from 2.9.6 to 2.10.0. Sparkle's minimum macOS rises to
  12; Parley requires 14, so nothing changes for you. This beta does not use
  the Sparkle feed.

## Fixes

- The notarized draft-release workflow read the runner's temporary folder
  from a place GitHub does not allow, so every push recorded a failed run of
  it with no jobs. The signing paths now sit on the steps that use them, and
  a script test guards the rule.

## Going back to v0.1.65

Nothing in this release changes saved reviews, workspaces or the agent
protocol (still 34). v0.1.65 reads everything this version writes.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked in the Tart VM against the new pins before the pull request: 597
native checks, 81 script tests, both scans, the build and the 25-round
soak. Not yet checked by hand in the app: the updated Ghostty renderer across
sleep and wake, and the v0.1.65 items still waiting for a hand test.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
